author: Gabriel O. Rodriguez Cruz
title: Weekly Scam Alert: Hurricane Season Fraud Ramps up With FEMA Impersonators, Fake Charities - NewsBreak
text:
By Gabriel O. Rodriguez Cruz Kaitlin Mulhere ,
8 hours ago Hurricane season officially began last week, and federal agencies are reminding consumers that where weather emergencies strike, fraudsters often follow. The Federal Trade Commission (FTC) recently published a consumer alert warning that hurricanes, like other natural disasters, can bring out scammers hoping to get your money and personal information while you’re stressed, rushed or recovering from the damages. Post-disaster fraud costs Americans nearly $10 billion annually, according to the National Insurance Crime Bureau — and a big chunk of that comes from hurricane season. Read full article
